items.quote: And Moses said unto the LORD, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.
items.claim: Moses recounts that God has commanded him to lead the people but has not revealed whom he will send, while stating God knows him by name and has granted him favor.
